items.title: Lockheed Martin is Down 8% in 6 Months: Wall Street Pro Expects 30% Growth Within a Year
items.summary: Lockheed Martin just delivered a blowout quarter with a record-breaking backlog, yet the stock sits near a six-month low while one Wall Street analyst sees nearly 30% upside. The real question is whether a single ugly quarter buried a defense giant or exposed something deeper.

items.title: Boeing's Finished Flight Test Counts Most For A Different Jet
items.summary: Monday's approval was already telegraphed, the rare double upgrade beside it was not, and the finished flight test frees engineering capacity for a different program entirely.

items.title: Lockheed, Northrop Team Up To Rebuild Weapon Stockpile
items.summary: The DOD tapped Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman to accelerate Patriot, THAAD production. Anduril looks to build unmanned boats.

items.title: Rocket Lab Stock's Deepest Falls Have Come From Rates, Not Rockets
items.summary: Rocket Lab stock is well off its high again, and its shock record says the most serious damage comes from rate moves rather than from anything on the launch pad.

items.title: Northrop Grumman To Boost Missile Component Production For ‘Arsenal of Freedom’ – Retail Views Steady Execution To Be Key For Growth
items.summary: The company, among other things, is doubling capacity at its Utah facilities to deliver solid rocket motors and nearly tripling capacity at the Allegany Ballistics Lab in West Virginia.

items.title: The Production Ramp That Could Repower Boeing Stock
items.summary: Boeing is delivering airplanes at a pace it has not managed in years, and almost none of the profit those airplanes will carry has shown up yet.

items.title: Northrop Grumman Enters $3 Billion Contracts to Increase Missile Defense Production
items.summary: Northrop Grumman signed two agreements totaling $3 billion to speed up production of missile interceptors.
